engine.description: postgres, mysql, mariadb, mongo, or redis.

public_port.description: Publish the database port on the host. Omit to keep it internal.

start.description: Start the container right away. Defaults to true.

compose_service.description: Required for compose stacks unless the stack has a main service.

main_service.description: Compose service new domains point at by default.

start.description: Run `docker compose up` right away. Defaults to false.
Run `docker compose up` right away. Defaults to true.

access_key_hint.description: Last four characters of the access key id.

compose_service.description: Compose service inside a stack that receives the traffic.

target_path.description: Host path for bind and path backups. Defaults to the original path.

target_service_id.description: Database or service to restore into. Defaults to the job's service.

target_volume.description: Volume name for volume backups. Defaults to the original volume.

encryption_passphrase.description: Client-side encryption passphrase. Empty string removes encryption.

schedule_cron.description: Five-field cron or a preset such as `@daily`. Empty string clears it.

compose_file.description: Path of the compose file inside the repository.

running.description: Null when the server cannot be reached.

generated_yaml.description: The file Rudder runs: project name, labels, and proxy network applied.

missing_variables.description: Referenced variables with no value under Environment.

generated.description: Secrets generated for empty fields. Shown once; they are stored encrypted.

kind.description: domain, string, email, secret, number, or boolean.

bearer.description: Scoped API token. Send `Authorization: Bearer rdr_...`.
